title: One line of events.jsonl, format version 2
description: A line of a repository run's normalized trace (docs/events-format.md). One JSON object per line; this schema validates one line. Within version 2 a kind and a field are only ever added, so a reader must ignore a kind it does not know (this schema allows any kind) and a field it does not know. A line with no `v` is a version 1 line, written before the version field existed; version 1 lines validate against repo_event.v1.json.

v.description: The format version of this line. Absent on a line written before the field existed.

kind.description: What the event is. Readers ignore a kind they do not know.

t.description: Seconds since the first timestamped trace line; null when the harness has no timestamps.

agent.description: The id of the parent's Agent/Task call that started this event; absent on the parent's events.

denied.description: The call was refused and never ran.

target.description: A probe event's target: what the command asked the host for (cpu, gpu, os, memory, packages, env, network).

pattern.description: A probe event's configured pattern that the command matched.

output.description: The command's output as the harness returned it, clipped to 8 KB.
